notablePrerequisites: There are at least five Elves on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.
